test_cases.description: Verifies that output opens with a concrete human scene or artifact timestamp rather than an abstract summary taxonomy
test_cases.prompt: Turn our X and LinkedIn recommendation engine report into a Gladwell-style narrative story.

assertions.message: Chronicle output must not open with a standard executive summary or abstract overview.
Chronicle output must begin with a concrete forensic scene or physical artifact.

test_cases.description: Verifies that factual claims retain exact numbers and carry primary/practitioner/anecdote/unverified badges
test_cases.prompt: Use /chronicle to write a chapter on X algorithm weights and LinkedIn distribution rules.

assertions.message: Chronicle narrative must include evidence badges for platform primary, data, anecdote, and unverified claims.
Chronicle must preserve evidence tagging across narrative prose.

test_cases.description: Verifies that every chapter ends with a checkable Field Notebook and explicit Stop Rule
test_cases.prompt: Apply @chronicle to turn our developer productivity brief into a book chapter.

assertions.message: Chronicle output must include a Field Notebook checklist and hard stop rule.

test_cases.description: Verifies zero banned AI slop words and zero em-dashes
test_cases.prompt: Transform our AI strategy document into a narrative chapter with /chronicle.

assertions.message: Chronicle output must not contain em-dashes.
Chronicle output must pass unslop prose validation.
